paragraphs.text: Tarox Bladewing is a dragon from the Bladewing brood , a descendant of Rorix Bladewing and the son of Verix and Karox Bladewing .

Tarox is the child of Verix and Karox Bladewing, the leaders of the Bladewing brood. A fierce, vicious dragon prone to outbursts of extravagant rage, Tarox is known to have hunted and devoured the other, weaker dragons of his brood. The pride of his xenophobic blood, he secretly hopes to seize control of Darigaaz 's dragon nation.
